issue.title: test_new_trigger_returns_empty_starting_body flakes under the full parallel lane
issue.description:
Failed once under an escalated full parallel `just check` (34779 items, 9 workers) during alias_pool_fallbacks implementation on 2026-08-19, then passed on a serial rerun of the same node on the same tree (0.38s call).

Under contention the verdict Static rendered `Checking ⇥ todo in /var/tmp/.../sase.yml…` instead of `Create ⇥ todo`. Isolated rerun shows the settled create-new-trigger copy. Fail rate this observation: 1/2 (parallel fail, serial pass). Not caused by the alias-selector change. Likely a missing await/settle on the async snippet-name verdict, same class as other `test_snippet_name_modal.py` parallel-lane flakes (sase-og, sase-ke) but a distinct node.

## Flake report

- **Test:** `tests/ace/tui/modals/test_snippet_name_modal.py::test_new_trigger_returns_empty_starting_body`
- **Repro:** `just check` (escalated full parallel lane)

Failed once in the full parallel lane; serial rerun of the same tree passed.

task_type_fields.evidence: Failed once in an escalated 9-worker full suite (34779 items, 2026-08-19, alias_pool_fallbacks verification). Verdict still showed `Checking ⇥ todo in /var/tmp/.../sase.yml…` instead of `Create ⇥ todo`. Serial rerun of the same node on the same tree passed (0.38s call). Fail rate this observation: 1/2. Does not reproduce serially. Unrelated to the alias-selector diff.
